newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TENERIFE DOMINATE BUT FALL 1-0 TO BRONDBY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TENERIFE DOMINATE BUT FALL 1-0 TO BRONDBY.

text.p: Danish side Brondby took home a valuable 1-0 win from their UEFA Cup quarter-final first leg at Tenerife on Tuesday after converting one of only two clear chances and surviviving relentless pressure from the home side.
Tenerife's best chance came with a second half penalty but Slavisa Jokanovic missed and the Spanish side suffered their first home defeat in a European competition.
Brondby tok the lead after 29 minutes when Soren Colding capitalised on a defensive mistake and found Ebbe Sand completely unmarked with goalkeeper Marcelo Ojeda stranded.

Apart from penalty miss, the best of Tenerife's many chances fell to Juanele Castano, who hit the post early in the first half, and Angel Vivar Dorado, who lobbed over the crossbar just after the break.
